lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੂਜੀ ਤਰਫ ਹੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh doojee taraph hai vekhahu nadar nihaal ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is on the wrong side. You can see this with your own eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੀਸੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phaahee phaathe mirag jiu sir deesai jamakaal ||
lines.translation: He is caught in the trap like the deer; the Messenger of Death hovers over his head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੁਧਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬੁਰੀ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਕਰਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: khudhiaa trisanaa ni(n)daa buree kaam krodh vikaraal ||
lines.translation: Hunger, thirst and slander are evil; sexual desire and anger are horrible.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਨੀ ਅਖੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: enee akhee nadar na aavaee jichar sabad na kare beechaar ||
lines.translation: These cannot be seen with your eyes, until you contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ ਚੂਕੈ ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh bhaavai sa(n)tokheeaa(n) chookai aal ja(n)jaal ||
lines.translation: Whoever is pleasing to You is content; all his entanglements are gone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mool rahai gur seviai gur pauRee bohith ||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, his capital is preserved. The Guru is the ladder and the boat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਗੀ ਤਤੁ ਲੈ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak lagee tat lai too(n) sachaa man sach ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, whoever is attached to the Lord receives the essence; O True Lord, You are found when the mind is true. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇਕੋ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਹੇਕੁ ਦਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: heko paadhar hek dar gur pauRee nij thaan ||
lines.translation: There is one path and one door. The Guru is the ladder to reach one's own place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂੜਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਚਉ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: rooRau thaakur naanakaa sabh sukh saachau naam ||2||
lines.translation: Our Lord and Master is so beautiful, O Nanak; all comfort and peace are in the Name of the True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapeenhai aap saaj aap pachhaaniaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself created Himself; He Himself understands Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਰੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿ ਚੰਦੋਆ ਤਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)bar dharat vichhoR cha(n)doaa taaniaa ||
lines.translation: Separating the sky and the earth, He has spread out His canopy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਥੰਮੑਾ ਗਗਨੁ ਰਹਾਇ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin tha(n)mhaa gagan rahaai sabad neesaaniaa ||
lines.translation: Without any pillars, He supports the sky, through the insignia of His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sooraj cha(n)d upaai jot samaaniaa ||
lines.translation: Creating the sun and the moon, He infused His Light into them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਏ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨੰਤੁ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: keee raat dina(n)t choj vidaaniaa ||
lines.translation: He created the night and the day; Wondrous are His miraculous plays.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਧਰਮ ਵੀਚਾਰ ਨਾਵਣ ਪੁਰਬਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: teerath dharam veechaar naavan purabaaniaa ||
lines.translation: He created the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where people contemplate righteousness and Dharma, and take cleansing baths on special occasions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh sar avar na koi k aakh vakhaaniaa ||
lines.translation: There is no other equal to You; how can we speak and describe You?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹੋਰ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sachai takhat nivaas hor aavan jaaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: You are seated on the throne of Truth; all others come and go in reincarnation. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਵਣਿ ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਚਹੁ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saavan je vasai chahu omaahaa hoi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when it rains in the month of Saawan, four are delighted:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਗਾਂ ਮਿਰਗਾਂ ਮਛੀਆਂ ਰਸੀਆਂ ਘਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naagaa(n) miragaa(n) machheeaa(n) raseeaa(n) ghar dhan hoi ||1||
lines.translation: the snake, the deer, the fish and the wealthy people who seek pleasure. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਵਣਿ ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਚਹੁ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saavan je vasai chahu vechhoRaa hoi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when it rains in the month of Saawan, four suffer the pains of separation:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਈ ਪੁਤਾ ਨਿਰਧਨਾ ਪੰਥੀ ਚਾਕਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gaaee putaa niradhanaa pa(n)thee chaakar hoi ||2||
lines.translation: the cow's calves, the poor, the travellers and the servants. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too sachaa sachiaar jin sach varataaiaa ||
lines.translation: You are True, O True Lord; You dispense True Justice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਠਾ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇ ਕਵਲੁ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: baithaa taaRee laai kaval chhapaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Like a lotus, You sit in the primal celestial trance; You are hidden from view.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਕਹਾਇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahamai vadaa kahaai a(n)t na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Brahma is called great, but even he does not know Your limits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਇ ਕਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa tis baap na maai kin too jaaiaa ||
lines.translation: You have no father or mother; who gave birth to You?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਵਰਨ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa tis roop na rekh varan sabaaiaa ||
lines.translation: You have no form or feature; You transcend all social classes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੁਖ ਪਿਆਸ ਰਜਾ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa tis bhukh piaas rajaa dhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: You have no hunger or thirst; You are satisfied and satiated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਸਮੋਇ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur mahi aap samoi sabad varataaiaa ||
lines.translation: You have merged Yourself into the Guru; You are pervading through the Word of Your Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sache hee pateeaai sach samaaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: When he is pleasing to the True Lord, the mortal merges in Truth. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੈਦੁ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ਵੈਦਗੀ ਪਕੜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲੇ ਬਾਂਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaid bulaaiaa vaidagee pakaR dha(n)dhole baa(n)h ||
lines.translation: The physician was called in; he touched my arm and felt my pulse.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੋਲਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕਰਕ ਕਲੇਜੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bholaa vaid na jaanaee karak kaleje maahi ||1||
lines.translation: The foolish physician did not know that the pain was in the mind. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੈਦਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਸੁਵੈਦੁ ਤੂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਰੋਗੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaidaa vaid suvaid too pahilaa(n) rog pachhaan ||
lines.translation: O physician, you are a competent physician, if you first diagnose the disease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa daaroo loR lahu jit va(n)njai rogaa ghaan ||
lines.translation: Prescribe such a remedy, by which all sorts of illnesses may be cured.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਰੋਗ ਉਠਿਅਹਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit daaroo rog uthiahi tan sukh vasai aai ||
lines.translation: Administer that medicine, which will cure the disease, and allow peace to come and dwell in the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਵੈਦੁ ਸਦਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: rog gavaaihi aapanaa ta naanak vaid sadaai ||2||
lines.translation: Only when you are rid of your own disease, O Nanak, will you be known as a physician. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਦੇਵ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes dev upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and the deities were created.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਦਿਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੂਜਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahame dite bed poojaa laaiaa ||
lines.translation: Brahma was given the Vedas, and enjoined to worship God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: das avataaree raam raajaa aaiaa ||
lines.translation: The ten incarnations, and Rama the king, came into being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੈਤਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਧਾਇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: daitaa maare dhaai hukam sabaaiaa ||
lines.translation: According to His Will, they quickly killed all the demons.

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਸ ਮਹੇਸੁਰੁ ਸੇਵ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ees mahesur sev tinhee a(n)t na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Shiva serves Him, but cannot find His limits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee keemat paai takhat rachaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He established His throne on the principles of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇ ਆਪੁ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: duneeaa dha(n)dhai laai aap chhapaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He enjoined all the world to its tasks, while He keeps Himself hidden from view.
